constraints: elementRef must be an XML root object (e.g. as returned by DOM Create XML Ref or DOM Parse XML source/variable); otherwise an error is generated.
Reference lifecycle (implied convention, not syntactically enforced): DOM XML document lifecycle: create/parse ref -> navigate/get/set elements and attributes -> export/close

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Frees the memory occupied by an XML tree, ending its DOM lifecycle.
